note: The RDO surface — the files whose change can alter a frame on the wire. The conformance gate requires a fresh certification ONLY when a commit touches one of these. Everything else (docs, client, reports, tests of unrelated modules) commits freely. Edit this file rather than the gate logic.

tier1.why: builds every frame — a change here alters every byte on the wire
Latin-1 encoder — silently reshapes any accented payload
the separator guards; a change moves what may be emitted

tier2.why: handlers that build and emit frames
the suite catalogue and the runner — the certification itself
scenarios the replay leg answers from
the error contract asserted by the suites

exclude.why: a unit test cannot change a frame the gateway emits
a component test cannot change a frame either
